name: Deva

source.note: The 2024 Deva. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against SRD 5.2.1 or the book. Unsure: the Hit Points, Divine Aid (its uses and spells) and the Shape-Shift details. Shape-Shift and Exalted Restoration are text only. The Abbot of Krezk uses this block under his own name.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.summary: If it dies away from its home plane, its body vanishes and it re-forms there with all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Holy Mace
actions.summary: A mace blow carrying a burst of radiant power.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Casts Detect Evil and Good at will; Commune and Raise Dead once a day each (Wis, DC 17).
actions.text: Wisdom is its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17); it needs no Material components. At will: Detect Evil and Good. 1/day each: Commune, Raise Dead.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.summary: Takes the form of a Humanoid or Beast, or returns to its true form.
actions.text: It keeps its mind and its ability to speak; the new form's body replaces its own until it changes back. Text only for the engine.

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid
bonus_actions.summary: Twice a day: casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration or Remove Curse.
bonus_actions.text: Uses the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action. The two uses cover all three spells.

summary: A radiant warrior angel: two holy mace blows, healing magic for allies, and resistance to magic.
